title: Install your AI agent
caption: Your first command: copy it, paste it into your terminal, press Enter.
paste: Open your terminal from step 1, paste this line and press Enter. It installs your AI agent.
docsWhy: Always there, even if this line ever changes. Some install pages need scrolling, so the line is here.
powershellHint: On Windows, use PowerShell: its prompt starts with PS C:\.
commandPromptHint: Command Prompt shows a prompt like C:\>, with no PS in front. Paste this line there.

claude-code.one: On Windows, 'irm' is not recognized means you are in Command Prompt: open PowerShell, or use the Command Prompt line above.
claude-code.two: Claude Code needs a paid Claude plan. The free plan does not include it, and the sign-in on the next Slide says so.

antigravity.one: On Windows, 'irm' is not recognized means you are in Command Prompt, not PowerShell: open PowerShell and paste again.
antigravity.two: The line stops with red text: that is what Help is for.

codex.one: A line that does not fit your computer fails at once: check that the right system is picked above.
codex.two: The line stops with red text: that is what Help is for.

copilot.one: GitHub Copilot needs an active Copilot subscription on your GitHub account; without it, the sign-in on the next Slide fails.
copilot.two: On Windows, GitHub asks for PowerShell 6 or higher, and winget must exist. A message saying it is not recognized: use Help.

helpLine: Stuck, or red text you do not understand? Press Help at the top right and paste the error.
worked: Done when the prompt comes back. Next, open a new terminal window.

your-first-command.title: Your first command
your-first-command.script: This is the first command you type in your terminal. It installs your AI agent. Pick your computer and your AI agent in the toolbar, and the page shows you the exact line. Press the big Copy button, paste into your terminal and press Enter.

official-docs-always.title: Official docs, always
official-docs-always.script: Next to the line is a button to the official docs of your AI agent. I give you the line so you do not have to scroll through a page that has no anchor, but the vendor is the source, so if the line ever stops working, the docs are one click away.

what-might-happen.title: What might happen
what-might-happen.script: A few things can go wrong, and they are listed under the line for your AI agent. On Windows the usual one is the wrong window: PowerShell and Command Prompt need different lines. If you see red text you do not understand, press Help at the top right, paste the error, and ask.

help.label: Your error
